name: SEO Optimization Check
description: Ensure Next.js pages are optimized for search engines
prompt:
Analyze Next.js page for SEO:
1. Missing or incomplete metadata (title, description, OG tags)
2. Improper heading hierarchy (h1, h2, h3)
3. Missing structured data (JSON-LD for products, reviews)
4. Image optimization (next/image usage)
5. Missing canonical URLs
6. Slow loading resources blocking render
7. Missing sitemap generation for dynamic routes

For this luxury wine e-commerce:
- Product pages need rich snippets (Product schema)
- Wine details should include AggregateRating schema
- Prices should be marked up with proper currency
- Breadcrumbs should be implemented
- Meta descriptions should be compelling for luxury market

Provide SEO improvements with Next.js 14 App Router best practices.
